claim: Researchers assess the network's design (mass output, SEO saturation, negligible human readership) as aimed at contaminating AI training and retrieval data — 'LLM grooming'. A NewsGuard audit found 10 leading chatbots repeating the network's false narratives ~33% of the time; DFRLab documented Pravda content accumulating in AI training data.
caveat: This is an attributed research assessment, not a proven intent. A peer-reviewed test (Alyukov et al., HKS Misinformation Review, Oct 2025) found much lower contamination rates on data-void prompts, disputing generalizability of audit figures.
